'''O'Evitt Piboi''' was an individual that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was once detained in [[The Warren (Dantooine)|The Warren]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SWG:AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of O'Evitt Piboi]]
O'Evitt Piboi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
